about.label: Texas Instruments
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company headquartered in Dallas, Texas. The company's focus is on developing analog chips and embedded processors, which account for more than 80% of its revenue.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce analogových čipů a procesorů pro průmysl a auta.

about.label: Microsoft
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Redmond, Washington. The company became influential in the rise of personal computers through software like Windows and has since expanded into areas such as Internet services, cloud computing, artificial intelligence, video gaming, and more.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která vyrábí Windows a Office a provozuje cloud Azure.

about.label: Nvidia
about.summary: American multinational technology company headquartered in Santa Clara, California. The company develops graphics processing units, systems on chips, and application programming interfaces for data science, high-performance computing, artificial intelligence, and mobile and automotive applications.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která navrhuje grafické procesory a čipy pro umělou inteligenci – dnes jejich největší dodavatel na světě.

about.label: Eli Lilly and Company
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, with offices in 18 countries. Its products are sold in approximately 125 countries.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyrábí léky na cukrovku a obezitu (Mounjaro, Zepbound), rakovinu a další onemocnění.

about.label: Tesla
about.summary: American multinational automotive and clean energy company. Headquartered in Austin, Texas, it designs, manufactures, and sells battery electric vehicles, stationary battery energy storage devices from home to grid-scale, solar panels and solar shingles, and related products and services.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce elektromobilů, bateriových úložišť a solárních systémů.

about.label: Palo Alto Networks
about.summary: American multinational cybersecurity company with headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The core product is a platform that includes advanced firewalls and cloud-based offerings that extend those firewalls to cover other aspects of security.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a cloudovou ochranu sítí.

about.label: Analog Devices
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company specializing in data conversion, signal processing, and power management technology, headquartered in Wilmington, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americká polovodičová firma specializovaná na převod a zpracování signálu a řízení napájení.

about.label: Johnson & Johnson
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and medical technologies corporation headquartered in New Brunswick, New Jersey.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí léky a zdravotnické prostředky.

about.label: CrowdStrike
about.summary: American cybersecurity technology company based in Austin, Texas. It provides endpoint security, threat intelligence, and cyberattack response services.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která chrání počítače a servery, sleduje hrozby a pomáhá řešit kybernetické útoky.

about.label: Amazon
about.summary: American multinational conglomerate engaged in e-commerce, retail, cloud computing, online advertising, digital streaming, entertainment, and artificial intelligence.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, největší internetový obchod na světě a největší poskytovatel cloudových služeb (AWS).

about.label: AbbVie
about.summary: American pharmaceutical company headquartered in North Chicago, Illinois. AbbVie produces drugs to treat a wide range of medical issues.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma se sídlem v North Chicagu, která vyrábí léky na širokou škálu onemocnění.

about.label: Alphabet Inc.
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate holding company headquartered in Mountain View, California.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, mateřská společnost Googlu a YouTube, která vydělává hlavně na reklamě a cloudu.

about.label: Broadcom
about.summary: American multinational designer, developer, manufacturer, and global supplier of a wide range of semiconductor and infrastructure software products.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce a dodavatel široké škály polovodičů a infrastrukturního softwaru.

about.label: Merck KGaA
about.summary: German multinational science and technology company headquartered in Darmstadt, with about 60,000 employees and a presence in 66 countries. Merck was founded in 1668 and is the world's oldest operating chemical and pharmaceutical company, as well as one of the largest pharmaceutical companies globally.
about.summary_cs: Německá vědecko-technologická firma, která vyrábí léky, laboratorní potřeby a materiály pro elektroniku.

about.label: Meta Platforms
about.summary: American multinational technology company and is one of the Big Tech companies. Meta owns and operates several prominent social media platforms and communication services, including Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger, and Threads.
about.summary_cs: Americká technologická firma, která provozuje Facebook, Instagram a WhatsApp a vydělává hlavně na reklamě.

about.label: Intuitive Surgical
about.summary: American biotechnology company that develops, manufactures, and markets robotic products designed to improve clinical outcomes of patients through minimally invasive surgery, most notably with the da Vinci Surgical System.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí chirurgické roboty da Vinci pro miniinvazivní operace.

about.label: Murata Manufacturing
about.summary: Japanese manufacturer of electronic components, based in Nagaokakyo, Kyoto.
about.summary_cs: Japonský výrobce elektronických součástek, největší producent keramických kondenzátorů na světě.

about.label: Iberdrola
about.summary: Spanish multinational electric utility company based in Bilbao, Spain. It has  around 40,000 employees and serves around 30 million customers.
about.summary_cs: Španělská energetická firma, jeden z největších výrobců elektřiny z obnovitelných zdrojů na světě.

about.label: Infineon Technologies
about.summary: German company which designs and manufactures semiconductor devices.
about.summary_cs: Německý výrobce polovodičů pro auta, energetiku a průmysl.

about.label: Novartis
about.summary: Swiss multinational pharmaceutical corporation based in Basel, Switzerland. Novartis manufactures the drugs clozapine, diclofenac, carbamazepine, valsartan, imatinib mesylate, cyclosporine, letrozole, methylphenidate, terbinafine, deferasirox, and others.
about.summary_cs: Švýcarská farmaceutická firma z Basileje, která vyvíjí léky na rakovinu, srdeční a imunitní onemocnění.

about.label: Micron Technology
about.summary: American multinational semiconductor company that manufactures computer memory and computer data storage products, including dynamic random-access memory, flash memory, High Bandwidth Memory, and solid-state drives.
about.summary_cs: Americký výrobce paměťových čipů (DRAM, flash) a SSD disků.

about.label: Cloudflare
about.summary: American technology company headquartered in San Francisco, California, that provides a range of internet services, including content delivery network services, cloud cybersecurity, DDoS mitigation, and ICANN-accredited domain registration. The company's services act primarily as a reverse proxy between website visitors and a customer's hosting provider, imp
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která zrychluje a chrání weby a online služby.

about.label: Fortinet
about.summary: American cybersecurity company headquartered in Sunnyvale, California. It develops and sells security products including firewalls, endpoint security and intrusion detection systems.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma pro kybernetickou bezpečnost, která vyrábí firewally a další ochranu sítí a zařízení.

about.label: AstraZeneca
about.summary: Swedish–British multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology company with its headquarters at the Cambridge Biomedical Campus in Cambridge, England. It has a portfolio of products for major diseases in areas including oncology, cardiovascular, gastrointestinal, infection,  neuroscience, respiratory, and inflammation.
about.summary_cs: Britsko-švédská farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na rakovinu, srdeční a plicní onemocnění.

about.label: Cisco
about.summary: American multinational technology conglomerate corporation that develops, manufactures, and sells hardware, software, telecommunications equipment and other high-technology services and products focused on networking, cybersecurity and AI. Cisco specializes in specific tech markets, such as the Internet of things, domain security, videoconferencing, and ener
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí síťová zařízení, například routery a switche, a software pro sítě a bezpečnost.

about.label: S&P Global
about.summary: American publicly traded corporation headquartered in Manhattan, New York.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která uděluje úvěrové ratingy, sestavuje burzovní indexy (např. S&P 500) a dodává finanční data.

about.label: Amgen
about.summary: American multinational biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Thousand Oaks, California. The company's major products are Prolia and XGEVA to treat osteoporosis and bone diseases, Repatha to treat hyperlipidemia, Otezla to treat psoriasis and psoriatic arthritis, Enbrel to treat autoimmune diseases, Evenity to treat osteoporosis, Tepezza to treat Graves'
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, jejíž hlavní léky léčí osteoporózu, vysoký cholesterol, lupénku a autoimunitní onemocnění.

holdings.name: XIAOMI
holdings.exchange: Hong Kong Exchanges And Clearing Ltd

about.label: Xiaomi
about.summary: Chinese multinational corporation and technology company headquartered in Beijing, China. It is best known for its consumer electronics, software, and electric vehicles.
about.summary_cs: Čínský výrobce mobilů, spotřební elektroniky a elektromobilů.

about.label: Gilead Sciences
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company headquartered in Foster City, California, that focuses on researching and developing antiviral drugs used in the treatment of HIV/AIDS, hepatitis B, hepatitis C, influenza, and COVID-19. It also develops medicines in therapeutic areas such as oncology and inflammation and cell therapy.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na HIV, žloutenku a rakovinu.

about.label: Pfizer
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical and biotechnology corporation headquartered at The Spiral in Manhattan, New York City. Pfizer develops and produces medication and vaccines for immunology, oncology, cardiology, endocrinology, and neurology.
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky a vakcíny.

about.label: Enel
about.summary: Italian multinational producer and distributor of electricity and gas.
about.summary_cs: Italská energetická firma, která vyrábí a rozvádí elektřinu a plyn, jedna z největších v Evropě.

about.label: SK Hynix
about.summary: South Korean semiconductor company that manufactures dynamic random-access memory chips and flash memory chips.
about.summary_cs: Jihokorejský výrobce paměťových čipů, hlavní dodavatel pamětí pro čipy umělé inteligence.

about.label: Northrop Grumman Corporation
about.summary: American aerospace and defense company that designs and manufactures systems for aeronautics, defense, missions, and space.
about.summary_cs: Americká obranná firma, která vyrábí letadla, rakety, satelity a kosmické systémy.

about.label: GE Vernova
about.summary: Energy equipment manufacturing and services company headquartered in Cambridge, Massachusetts.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která vyrábí plynové a větrné turbíny a zařízení pro rozvodné sítě; vznikla oddělením od General Electric.

about.label: Danaher Corporation
about.summary: American healthcare company headquartered in Washington, D.C.. It develops products used for advances in biotechnology, life sciences, and diagnostics. The company operates three divisions: biotechnology, which develops products for the development of therapeutics; life sciences, which develops products to identify causes of disease, new therapies, and to te
about.summary_cs: Americká zdravotnická firma, která vyrábí produkty pro biotechnologie, vědy o živé přírodě a diagnostiku.

about.label: Vertex Pharmaceuticals
about.summary: American biopharmaceutical company based in Boston, Massachusetts. It was one of the first biotech firms to use an explicit strategy of rational drug design rather than combinatorial chemistry.
about.summary_cs: Americká biofarmaceutická firma, která vyvíjí léky hlavně na cystickou fibrózu a další vážná onemocnění.

about.label: Air Products & Chemicals
about.summary: U.S.-based international corporation whose principal business is selling gases and chemicals for industrial use.
about.summary_cs: Americká firma, která prodává průmyslové plyny a chemikálie.

about.label: Bristol-Myers Squibb
about.summary: American multinational pharmaceutical company headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey. The company's primary products are apixaban for people with atrial fibrillation; nivolumab, used to treat certain types of cancer; lenalidomide, used to treat multiple myeloma, smoldering myeloma, and myelodysplastic syndromes; abatacept, used to treat autoimmune diseases s
about.summary_cs: Americká farmaceutická firma, jejíž hlavní léky slouží k prevenci mrtvice, léčbě rakoviny, mnohočetného myelomu a autoimunitních onemocnění.
